caption: The drawing shows a rectangular wooden cabinet mounted on a plain background. The cabinet is painted in a muted blue-green color and has a single door with a round, brown knob on the left side. The center panel of the door features a decorative painting with a green background that shows three birds perched among pink and red flowers, green stems, and leaves. Below the birds and flowers, the year "1836" is inscribed in bold black numbers. The cabinet has visible wood grain texture, with simple, carved molding along the top and bottom edges. The composition is vertically centered on a beige, blank background, with a faint rectangular outline sketched below the cabinet and the name "Angelo Bulone" in small text at the bottom right.
title: Zoar Blue Bonnet Cabinet
